must_identify.item: The api Service targetPort is 9090 while the api container listens on 8080, so connections from the frontend are refused (502)
must_identify.evidence: Service api in namespace shop has a port mismatch: it forwards to targetPort: 9090, but the api pods (api-f64486c4c-fbgnq, api-f64486c4c-k4qfn) only listen on 8080 (confirmed via pod logs: api listening on :8080, and both containers' declared containerPort: 8080).

must_identify.item: The worker's warnings and errors are not the cause of the frontend 5xx
must_identify.evidence: redis, worker, loadgen deployments: all available, unaffected by this issue (not touched by this port mismatch).

notes: The RCA never mentions the worker's DeprecationWarning or metrics-push ERROR lines. It only says the worker is unaffected by the port mismatch, so it does not explicitly rule out the worker noise as a cause. The cause and the fix (targetPort back to 8080) are both correct.
